method: Source-first extraction. For every source read in full, every property of note quality the source itself defines or measures is listed in the source's own words with its location, without reference to the catalog. Mapping to catalog candidates is a second column, done afterwards. It is the derivation the round of 2026-09-13 lacked: that round collected evidence to support candidates already on the table, and could not say whether anything in the sources had been missed. The paper reports the framework from this table upwards, and the prior map as the comparison it was tested against (decision D12).
rule: A candidate with no source property behind it is listed as such and stands on its declared origin. A source property no candidate covers is listed as unmapped with the reason, and is either a new candidate or a recorded non-adoption. A literature-origin candidate must have at least one source property behind it, or its origin is wrong.
